title: fix: retain Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite via Vercel and OpenRouter
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite` to Vercel Chat Completions pinned to Google, with generic fallback pinned to OpenRouter AI Studio. Preserves IDs, aliases, paid-only access, and `priceMultiplier: 1`.
- Moves existing `:search` to OpenRouter AI Studio with Exa. Capability change: ordinary requests lose native Google Search; search uses Exa instead of Google grounding. Other modalities, reasoning, ordinary tools, and endpoints pass. Search has no fallback because Vercel Chat cannot preserve search.
- Verifies [Vercel](https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models), [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite/endpoints), and [Exa](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/features/server-tools/web-search) pricing. OpenRouter token/search/storage costs include 5.5%; search costs $7.385/1K calls. Fallback retains the Vercel customer quote; Pollinations absorbs extra costs.
- Passes real-provider authenticated Worker E2E, forced fallback, streaming usage, cache, aliases, permissions/errors, ten concurrent requests per route, 274 Gen tests, 63 pricing/snapshot tests, and both typechecks. Cached repeats on all three routes preserve text/attribution with no extra provider calls, debits, or billed events. Wallet/staging Tinybird reconcile at 0.09551782 Pollen; zero quarantined events.
- Avoids [Vertex retirement](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/model-versions); availability depends on existing-provider access under [Gemini API restrictions](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations). Our direct AI Studio key returns 404 for 2.5; 3.5 succeeds. No deployment or secret changes.

gist.headline: Gemini finds another garden path
gist.blurb: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite gets a new route through Vercel, with OpenRouter ready as a fallback. Its search variant takes a separate path through Exa; apparently even models need directions.
gist.summary: Routes google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite through Vercel Chat Completions pinned to Google, with an OpenRouter AI Studio fallback; its :search variant uses OpenRouter with Exa search instead of Google grounding.
gist.impact: Paid users keep the same model IDs, aliases, and price multiplier of 1; search requests use Exa, while the search route has no fallback because Vercel Chat cannot preserve search.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite as a small glowing star traveling along two garden paths: a primary route marked by a simple Vercel triangle and a fallback route through an OpenRouter-style junction. A separate magnifying glass marks the Exa search path. Polli, wearing a tiny map-reader's cap, points out the routes among code-plants.
